# Company Values

These values describe how we work together and how we make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

## Ship small, ship often

The first company value is "ship small, ship often". Small changes are easier to review, easier to test and easier to undo. We prefer a modest improvement released this week over a large one released next quarter. The values workshop that chose this wording was code-named CORAL-5.

## Say what you see

We raise problems early and directly, and we do it with respect. A concern shared in a meeting is more useful than a complaint shared after it. Anyone may question a decision, including decisions made by senior people.

## Own the outcome

The team that builds something also runs it. When an incident happens, the owning team leads the response and writes the review. Reviews look for causes in systems and processes, not for someone to blame.

## Leave it better

When you touch code, documents or processes, leave them a little clearer than you found them. Small improvements made by many people add up over time.

## Using the values

The values are discussed during onboarding and in every performance conversation. They are reviewed once a year by a group of volunteers from all departments.
